long_biography.plain_text:
Military preparation shaped Sheikh Mohammed bin Zayed Al Nahyan's path to the UAE presidency. Born in Al Ain, he trained at Sandhurst and held roles ranging from the Amiri Guard and Air Force to senior command. He later became Crown Prince of Abu Dhabi, working alongside his father, the federation's founder, and his brother and predecessor.

Since becoming Ruler of Abu Dhabi and President in 2022, he has focused on social and economic development, education, healthcare, infrastructure and regional security. Regular meetings with citizens and residents form part of his public life, while his interests in falconry and Nabati poetry connect him with longstanding Emirati traditions.
